system.description:
As your touch shapes flesh, so it grasps and twists bone — moving, lengthening, bending or compressing it, or dragging it clean through the flesh around it.

Grab the victim and work the bone. Used alone, each such strike inflicts one level of lethal damage as bone warps and tears through flesh. Combined with Fleshcraft, it lets you completely restructure a subject's appearance, height and body, or raise defensive spines and bone weapons — and such crafted spurs let their bearer inflict lethal damage with otherwise unarmed attacks. Like all Vicissitude, it uses Crafts: Body Crafts for retests.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Permanent (heals as aggravated wound on weaker generations)
